method: full verification of the git tree at HEAD: every package blob hashed via git cat-file and compared with the index; presence checks both directions (index->tree, tree->index)

integrityProtection.index: EVIDENCE-INDEX.md records the SHA-256 of EVIDENCE-INDEX.json and ENVIRONMENT.json; the git commit SHA anchors every file, and any later edit of a published file without regenerating the index shows up here as a hash mismatch

evolution.metricDefinition: indexEntries = published files (evidence + top-level deliverables + integrity anchors). Local evidence file counts are a different metric (files in the local evidence directory, including harness-internal ones never published).
